endings.name: Rule Three
endings.summary: Fisk breaks the last rule and crosses the fence on night 7. Only a body that has eaten enough survives the cold, so he reaches the trees already changing. If Jax came, Jax stopped in the snow. 'Deep down, this would only spread.'

endings.name: Call Me Sam
endings.summary: Fisk reported Jax and took Sam's key. He stays in on night 7 because staff are not called. He is kept on, and the game ends with him walking a new recruit down the tall halls and giving him the three rules.

endings.name: Transferred
endings.summary: Fisk refused the meat and never followed the call. He is too weak to work and no use to the project. He is put on a truck. Sam tells the bunk that he was transferred, and Fisk never learns what the base was for.

endings.name: The Zoo
endings.summary: As written. Fisk eats, follows the flute with Jax, meets the pale figure, is gassed and taken to the cave. Sam explains the project. Fisk wakes transformed, a tube in his arm, 'like an animal in a zoo'. Every other run that reaches night 7 without one of the three ways out ends here too: the base takes him another way.
